keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «반딧불이는 자유롭고 싶어 한다(교훈)» 와 «톰이 병을 열어 놓아준다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the lesson (the fireflies want to be free) and the ending (Tom opens the jar and lets them go). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why does the jar glow like a small lamp?
opts: Tom puts a candle in it.
evs: Tom catches some fireflies in a jar.
On a summer night, Tom and Lily go to the field.
But Lily says, "They want to be free."

why: «Tom catches some fireflies in a jar.» 빛을 내는 반딧불이가 병 안에 있어서 병이 빛나요.
Tom catches fireflies in the jar, and fireflies make light.

qs.q: Lily says, "They want to be free." What does "free" mean here?
qs.qko: 릴리가 «They want to be free.» 라고 말해요. 여기서 «free» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: able to fly where they want
evs: Tom opens the jar, and the fireflies fly up to the stars.
Little lights fly in the dark.
The jar glows like a small lamp.
On a summer night, Tom and Lily go to the field.
why: «Tom opens the jar, and the fireflies fly up to the stars.» 병에서 나와 마음껏 날아가니, 자유롭다는 뜻이에요.
When Tom opens the jar, the fireflies fly up to the stars. Free means able to fly where they want.

qs.q: Why does Tom open the jar?
opts: Lily says the fireflies want to be free.
evs: But Lily says, "They want to be free."
Tom opens the jar, and the fireflies fly up to the stars.
Tom catches some fireflies in a jar.
The jar glows like a small lamp.
why: 릴리가 반딧불이는 자유롭고 싶어 한다고 말했고(«But Lily says...»), 그래서 톰이 병을 열었어요(«Tom opens the jar...»).
Lily says they want to be free, and then Tom opens the jar.

ends: Tom and Lily watch the fireflies every summer night.
Tom and Lily draw pictures of fireflies and stars.
톰과 릴리는 반딧불이와 별 그림을 그린다.

write.src: “Let’s <u>let the fireflies go</u> before <u>it gets late</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 뒤에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and what happens after it in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)
